## Publication Information

**Date:** 1856

**Imprint:** <i>MP</i> 12 (December 1856), 414-64.

**Notes:** Reprinted in <i>Lucy and Christian Wainwright and other stories</i> (1863) with that story, ‘Bygone Days’, ‘A Household Record’, ‘The Two Beauties’, ‘Will No One do Likewise?’ and ‘The Lost are Found’.
